I'm an Apple fanboy, but I use this MS Wireless Laser Mouse 8000 with my Macbook Pro:  http://www.amazon.com/Microsoft-Wireless-Laser-Mouse-8000/dp...  I like it because I can switch to my right and left hand (I'm right handed). I used to get the sore finger and shoulders, so I switch sides often (every hour). The Bluetooth works without using the USB dongle but it's a bit flaky connecting sometimes. So I use the dongle now and I rarely have any connection problems or lagging. The rechargeable cradle works great and stays out of the way. Since I'm on OSX, I have to use SteerMouse to be able to customize all the extra buttons.
 http://www.plentycom.jp/en/steermouse/
